title: Kogeziya: bog‘lovchi vositalar
goal_uz: Dars oxirida havola, almashtirish, ellipsis va ilg‘or bog‘lovchilar yordamida matnni mexanik bog‘lashsiz ravon va izchil qilib tahrir qila olasiz.

scenes.title: Matnni bir butun qilamiz
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Oldingi darsda nominalizatsiya va akademik uslubni o‘rgandik: fe’lni otga aylantirib, matnni zich qilish. Bugun navbat zichlikdan bog‘lanishga. Dars oxirida gaplar va xatboshilarni havola, almashtirish, tushirib qoldirish va ilg‘or bog‘lovchilar yordamida mohirona bog‘lay olasiz, shu bilan birga mexanik, zerikarli bog‘lashdan qochasiz.
scenes.say: Welcome back. Last time we packed ideas into dense academic noun phrases. Today we ask a different question: how do those sentences hold together as one text?
scenes.say_uz: Xush kelibsiz. O‘tgan safar g‘oyalarni zich akademik ot birikmalariga joyladik. Bugun boshqa savol: bu gaplar qanday qilib bir butun matn bo‘lib birikadi?

scenes.title: Kogeziya va koherensiya
board: Cohesion = grammar/lexis links on the page

examples.t: Cohesion is visible; coherence is felt.
examples.uz: Kogeziya ko‘rinadi; koherensiya sezilady.

scenes.say_native: Ikki atamani farqlaymiz. Kogeziya bu matndagi ko‘rinadigan bog‘lovchi vositalar: olmoshlar, bog‘lovchilar, takrorlanuvchi so‘zlar. Koherensiya esa g‘oyalarning mantiqan mos kelishi. Bog‘lovchilar ko‘p, lekin mantiq yo‘q matn ham bo‘lishi mumkin. Esse baholanganda ikkalasi ham tekshiriladi, shuning uchun biz vositalarni mantiq xizmatiga qo‘yamiz.
scenes.say: Cohesion is visible; coherence is felt. Cohesion is made of grammar and vocabulary links on the page, while coherence means the ideas make sense together.
scenes.say_uz: Kogeziya ko‘rinadi, koherensiya sezilib turadi. Kogeziya sahifadagi grammatik va leksik bog‘lanishlardan iborat, koherensiya esa g‘oyalarning birgalikda mantiqli bo‘lishidir.

scenes.title: Havola: nimaga ishora qilyapti?
board: it · they · this · that · such · these

examples.t: Sales rose in May. This surprised analysts.
examples.uz: Sotuv mayda oshdi. Bu tahlilchilarni hayron qoldirdi.

examples.t: Researchers tested the drug; they found no effect.
examples.uz: Tadqiqotchilar dorini sinadi; ular ta’sir topmadi.

scenes.say_native: Birinchi nuqta: havola. Olmosh yoki ko‘rsatish so‘zi oldingi gapdagi narsaga ishora qiladi: it, they, this, that, such. Bu o‘zbekchadagi “bu”, “shu”, “ular” kabi ishlaydi. Asosiy shart bitta: o‘quvchi ishora nimaga qaratilganini darhol tushunishi kerak. Agar ikkita nomzod bo‘lsa, havola noaniq bo‘ladi va matn charchatadi.
scenes.say: Sales rose in May. This surprised analysts. Researchers tested the drug, and they found no effect. A reference word points back, and the reader must know exactly what it points to.
scenes.say_uz: Sotuv mayda oshdi. Bu tahlilchilarni hayron qoldirdi. Tadqiqotchilar dorini sinadi va ular hech qanday ta’sir topmadi. Havola so‘zi orqaga ishora qiladi va o‘quvchi aynan nimaga ishora qilayotganini bilishi kerak.

scenes.title: This + yig‘uvchi ot
board: this trend · this shift · this finding
= a whole idea in two words

examples.t: Fewer people buy print. This trend is accelerating.
examples.uz: Bosma nashr olayotganlar kamaymoqda. Bu tendensiya tezlashmoqda.

examples.t: Wages stagnated. This development fuelled protest.
examples.uz: Maosh o‘smadi. Bu holat noroziliklarni kuchaytirdi.

scenes.say_native: Yuqori darajali yozuvning belgisi: yolg‘iz “this” o‘rniga “this” va yig‘uvchi ot. This trend, this shift, this finding, this development, this phenomenon. Bunday ot oldingi butun gap mazmunini bitta tushunchaga o‘rab beradi va aytilgan fikrni aniq nomlaydi. O‘zbek tilida “bu holat”, “bu jarayon” deganga o‘xshaydi, lekin inglizcha akademik uslubda bu deyarli majburiy.
scenes.say: Fewer people buy print newspapers. This trend is accelerating. Wages stagnated for a decade. This development fuelled protest. The noun after this names the whole idea.
scenes.say_uz: Bosma gazeta sotib oladiganlar kamaymoqda. Bu tendensiya tezlashmoqda. Maosh o‘n yil o‘smadi. Bu holat noroziliklarni kuchaytirdi. This dan keyingi ot butun g‘oyani nomlaydi.

scenes.title: Orqaga va oldinga ishora
board: Anaphoric: the former · the latter · the above

examples.t: Both plans failed; the former was too costly.
examples.uz: Ikkala reja ham barbod bo‘ldi; birinchisi juda qimmat edi.

examples.t: The reasons are as follows.
examples.uz: Sabablar quyidagicha.

scenes.say_native: Orqaga ishora anafora deyiladi, oldinga ishora katafora. Orqaga: the former va the latter, ya’ni ikki narsadan birinchisi va ikkinchisi; the above; such measures. Oldinga: the following, as follows. Muhim: the former va the latter faqat ikkita narsa uchun. Uch narsa bo‘lsa, ishlatmang. Ular rasmiy uslubda zich, lekin ko‘p ishlatsangiz o‘quvchi orqaga qaytib o‘qishga majbur bo‘ladi.
scenes.say: Both plans failed; the former was too costly, the latter too vague. The reasons are as follows. Such measures rarely work. Remember, the former and the latter are only for two items.
scenes.say_uz: Ikkala reja ham barbod bo‘ldi; birinchisi juda qimmat, ikkinchisi juda mujmal edi. Sabablar quyidagicha. Bunday choralar kamdan-kam ishlaydi. Esda tuting, the former va the latter faqat ikki narsa uchun.

scenes.title: Noaniq this
board: ✗ The company fired staff and cut prices. This was unwise.
scenes.say_native: Eng keng tarqalgan xato: yolg‘iz “this” noaniq qolishi. Birinchi misolda “this” nimaga ishora qiladi: ishdan bo‘shatishgami, narx kamaytirishgami yoki ikkalasigami? Tuzatish uchun “this” dan keyin ot qo‘ying, masalan “this combination”, yoki ishorani aniq ob’ektga aylantiring. Bu o‘zbek va rus tilidagi “eto” bilan ham uchraydigan muammo, inglizchada esa jazosi og‘irroq.
scenes.say: The company fired staff and cut prices. This was unwise. Unclear. Better: This combination was unwise. Or: Cutting prices was unwise.
scenes.say_uz: Kompaniya xodimlarni ishdan bo‘shatdi va narxlarni tushirdi. Bu bema’ni edi. Noaniq. Yaxshiroq: bu uyg‘unlik bema’ni edi. Yoki: narxni tushirish bema’ni edi.

scenes.title: Nimaga ishora qiladi?
board: 1 Prices fell, and sales rose. This puzzled us.
2 Anna and Ben applied; the latter got the job.
3 Fix: He lied and left. This hurt her.
scenes.say_native: Uchta topshiriq. Birinchi, birinchi gapdagi “this” nimaga ishora qiladi va u qanchalik aniq? Ikkinchi, “the latter” kim? Uchinchi, uchinchi gapdagi noaniq “this” ni yig‘uvchi ot bilan tuzating. Pauza qiling va javob bering.
scenes.say: One: Prices fell, and sales rose. This puzzled us. What does this refer to? Two: Anna and Ben applied; the latter got the job. Who is the latter? Three: fix the vague this: He lied and left. This hurt her.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: narxlar tushdi va sotuv oshdi. Bu bizni hayron qoldirdi. This nimaga ishora qiladi? Ikki: Anna va Ben ariza berdi; ikkinchisi ishni oldi. Ikkinchisi kim? Uch: noaniq this ni tuzating.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 3 This behaviour / This betrayal hurt her.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: “this” ikkala voqeaga ishora qiladi, shuning uchun aniqroq “this combination” yoki “this contradiction”. Ikkinchi: the latter bu Ben, chunki u ikkinchi aytilgan. Uchinchi: “This behaviour hurt her” yoki “This betrayal hurt her”. Qarang, tanlangan ot sizning bahoyingizni ham bildiradi: betrayal, ya’ni xiyonat, behaviour dan kuchliroq.
scenes.say: One: this refers to both events, so say this combination. Two: the latter is Ben. Three: This behaviour hurt her, or, with a stronger judgement, This betrayal hurt her.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: this ikkala voqeaga ishora qiladi, shuning uchun this combination deng. Ikki: ikkinchisi Ben. Uch: This behaviour hurt her, yoki kuchliroq bahoda: This betrayal hurt her.

scenes.title: Almashtirish: one, do so, so
board: do so → replaces a verb phrase

examples.t: I prefer the red scarf to the blue one.
examples.uz: Men qizil sharfni ko‘kidan afzal ko‘raman.

examples.t: Staff were asked to leave and did so quietly.
examples.uz: Xodimlardan ketish so‘raldi va ular jimgina shunday qilishdi.

scenes.say_native: Almashtirishda takrorlanayotgan so‘z o‘rniga boshqa so‘z qo‘yamiz. “One” yoki “ones” sanaladigan otni almashtiradi. “Do so” butun fe’l birikmasini almashtiradi va rasmiy uslubga xos. “So” va “not” esa butun gapni: I think so, I hope not. Bu o‘zbekchadagi “shunday qildi”, “shunday deb o‘ylayman” ga yaqin. Almashtirish takrorni yo‘qotadi, lekin ma’noni saqlaydi.
scenes.say: I prefer the red scarf to the blue one. Staff were asked to leave and did so quietly. Will it rain? I think so. I hope not. Substitution removes repetition and keeps the meaning.
scenes.say_uz: Men qizil sharfni ko‘kidan afzal ko‘raman. Xodimlardan ketish so‘raldi va ular jimgina shunday qilishdi. Yomg‘ir yog‘adimi? Menimcha, shunday. Umid qilamanki, yo‘q. Almashtirish takrorni yo‘qotadi, ma’noni saqlaydi.

scenes.title: Almashtirish ishda
board: Do so = do + the same thing
Those who wish to do so may apply.

examples.t: Those wishing to apply may do so online.
examples.uz: Ariza bermoqchi bo‘lganlar buni onlayn qilishlari mumkin.

examples.t: She resigned, and her deputy did likewise.
examples.uz: U iste’foga chiqdi va o‘rinbosari ham shunday qildi.

scenes.say_native: Rasmiy hujjatlarda “do so” ayniqsa tez-tez uchraydi: “Those wishing to apply may do so online”. Fe’lni qaytarmaysiz, “do so” qo‘yasiz. “Do likewise” va “do the same” ham xuddi shunday: she resigned and her deputy did likewise. Esda tuting, “do so” harakat fe’llari bilan ishlatiladi. Holat fe’llari bilan, masalan know yoki seem, odatda ishlamaydi.
scenes.say: Those wishing to apply may do so online. She resigned, and her deputy did likewise. Notice that do so replaces an action, not a state.
scenes.say_uz: Ariza bermoqchi bo‘lganlar buni onlayn qilishlari mumkin. U iste’foga chiqdi va o‘rinbosari ham shunday qildi. Esda tuting, do so harakatni almashtiradi, holatni emas.

scenes.title: Ellipsis: tushirib qoldirish
board: Leave out words the reader can recover
same subject after and/but → no repeat

examples.t: Some voted for the plan; others against.
examples.uz: Ba’zilar rejaga ovoz berdi; boshqalar qarshi.

examples.t: He opened the file and read it carefully.
examples.uz: U faylni ochdi va uni diqqat bilan o‘qidi.

scenes.say_native: Ellipsis bu o‘quvchi o‘zi tiklay oladigan so‘zlarni tushirib qoldirish. “Some voted for the plan, others against”: ikkinchi qismda “voted” ni takrorlamadik. Bir xil ega bilan ikkita fe’l kelganda egani qaytarmaymiz: “He opened the file and read it”, “and he read it” emas. O‘zbek tilida ega tushirilishi tabiiy, shuning uchun bu sizga oson; inglizchada esa faqat ba’zi joylarda mumkinligini bilish kerak.
scenes.say: Some voted for the plan; others against. She wrote the report; he, the summary. He opened the file and read it carefully. Ellipsis leaves out what the reader can easily recover.
scenes.say_uz: Ba’zilar rejaga ovoz berdi; boshqalar qarshi. U hisobotni yozdi; u, xulosani. U faylni ochdi va uni diqqat bilan o‘qidi. Ellipsis o‘quvchi osongina tiklay oladigan narsani tushirib qoldiradi.

scenes.title: Almashtirishdagi xatolar
board: ✗ I need some advice; give me one.
✗ Prices rose, and it surprised us.
scenes.say_native: Ikki keng tarqalgan xato. Birinchi, “one” faqat sanaladigan ot uchun, advice esa sanalmaydi, shuning uchun “give me some”. Ikkinchi, butun gapga “it” bilan ishora qilish. “Prices rose, and it surprised us” noto‘g‘ri; bu yerda “which” kerak: “Prices rose, which surprised us”. Yoki alohida gap: “This surprised us”. O‘zbek tilida “bu” hammasini ko‘taradi, inglizchada esa olmoshlarning vazifasi qat’iyroq.
scenes.say: I need some advice. Give me some, not one. Prices rose, which surprised us. Not: and it surprised us. Use which, or start a new sentence with this.
scenes.say_uz: Menga maslahat kerak. Menga some bering, one emas. Narxlar oshdi, bu bizni hayron qoldirdi. Which ishlating yoki this bilan yangi gap boshlang.

scenes.title: Takrorni yo‘qoting
board: 1 I lost my old phone, so I bought a new phone.
2 He wanted to join, and he did join.
3 Some like jazz; others like rock.
scenes.say_native: Har bir gapni takrorsiz qayta yozing. Birinchi gapda ikkinchi “phone” o‘rniga nima qo‘yasiz? Ikkinchi gapda “and he did join” o‘rniga? Uchinchi gapda ellipsis bilan qisqartiring. Qisqa pauza qiling va ayting.
scenes.say: Rewrite without repetition. One: I lost my old phone, so I bought a new phone. Two: He wanted to join, and he did join. Three: Some like jazz; others like rock.
scenes.say_uz: Takrorsiz qayta yozing. Bir: eski telefonimni yo‘qotdim, shuning uchun yangi telefon sotib oldim. Ikki: u qo‘shilmoqchi edi va qo‘shildi. Uch: ba’zilar jazni yoqtiradi; boshqalar rokni.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1 ... so I bought a new one.
2 He wanted to join, and did so.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: “so I bought a new one”. Ikkinchi: “He wanted to join and did so”, yoki yanada ixchamroq, “He wanted to join and did”. Uchinchi: “Some like jazz; others, rock”. Yozishda vergul tushirilgan fe’l o‘rnini ko‘rsatadi. Bu uchta usul bitta narsani qiladi: takrorni olib tashlaydi, lekin o‘quvchi uchun yo‘lni ochiq qoldiradi.
scenes.say: One: so I bought a new one. Two: He wanted to join and did so. Three: Some like jazz; others, rock. The comma in the third marks the missing verb.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: shuning uchun yangisini sotib oldim. Ikki: u qo‘shilmoqchi edi va qo‘shildi. Uch: ba’zilar jazni yoqtiradi; boshqalar, rokni. Uchinchi gapdagi vergul tushgan fe’lni ko‘rsatadi.

scenes.title: Ilg‘or bog‘lovchilar: xarita
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi nuqta: ilg‘or bog‘lovchilar. C1 darajada “but, so, and” yetarli emas. Biz ularni ma’no bo‘yicha guruhlaymiz: qo‘shish, qarama-qarshilik, sabab va natija, ruxsat berish ya’ni konsessiya, shart va qayta ifodalash. Har biri ikki parametr bo‘yicha tanlanadi: ma’nosi va uslubi. Hamma bog‘lovchi hamma joyga mos kelmaydi.
scenes.say: At C1 level, but, so and and are not enough. Linkers fall into groups: addition, contrast, cause and result, concession, condition and reformulation. Choose by meaning and by register.
scenes.say_uz: C1 darajada but, so va and yetarli emas. Bog‘lovchilar guruhlarga bo‘linadi: qo‘shish, qarama-qarshilik, sabab va natija, konsessiya, shart va qayta ifodalash. Ma’no va uslub bo‘yicha tanlang.

scenes.title: Qo‘shish

examples.t: Moreover, the scheme is cheap.
examples.uz: Bundan tashqari, bu sxema arzon.

examples.t: Not only is it cheap, but it is also fast.
examples.uz: U nafaqat arzon, balki tezkor ham.

scenes.say_native: Qo‘shish uchun: moreover va furthermore, ikkalasi rasmiy, gap boshida, vergul bilan. “What is more” biroz erkinroq va ta’kidlaydi. “In addition to” dan keyin ot yoki -ing keladi, gap emas. “Not only” gap boshida kelsa, inversiya bo‘ladi: “Not only is it cheap”. “On top of that” esa og‘zaki nutqqa xos, esse uchun emas. Moreover aytganingizda yangi dalil avvalgisidan kam emas, ammo kuchliroq bo‘lishi kerak.
scenes.say: Moreover, the scheme is cheap. In addition to being cheap, it is fast. Not only is it cheap, but it is also fast. On top of that is spoken, not essay English.
scenes.say_uz: Bundan tashqari, sxema arzon. Arzon bo‘lishidan tashqari, u tez. U nafaqat arzon, balki tez ham. On top of that og‘zaki nutqqa xos, esse tiliga emas.

scenes.title: Qarama-qarshilik

examples.t: The plan is costly; nevertheless, it will go ahead.
examples.uz: Reja qimmat; shunga qaramay, u amalga oshadi.

examples.t: The results were useful, albeit limited.
examples.uz: Natijalar foydali, garchi cheklangan edi.

scenes.say_native: Qarama-qarshilik eng boy guruh. However, nevertheless, nonetheless, even so: bular “shunga qaramay” ma’nosida, nevertheless va nonetheless eng rasmiy. Whereas va while ikki faktni solishtiradi. “Albeit” bu “garchi”, undan keyin odatda to‘liq gap emas, sifat yoki ibora keladi: “useful, albeit limited”. “Notwithstanding” esa old ko‘makchi: “notwithstanding the cost”, ya’ni xarajatga qaramay. Hammasini bir gapda ishlatmaysiz, lekin har birini o‘z o‘rniga qo‘ying.
scenes.say: The plan is costly; nevertheless, it will go ahead. Urban rents rise, whereas rural rents fall. The results were useful, albeit limited. Notwithstanding the cost, the project continued.
scenes.say_uz: Reja qimmat; shunga qaramay, u amalga oshadi. Shahar ijarasi ko‘tariladi, qishloqniki esa tushadi. Natijalar foydali, garchi cheklangan edi. Xarajatga qaramay, loyiha davom etdi.

scenes.title: However bilan ikkita gap
board: ✗ The plan is costly, however it will go ahead.
✓ The plan is costly; however, it will go ahead.
✗ Although it is costly, but it will go ahead.
✓ Although it is costly, it will go ahead.
scenes.say_native: Ikki xato. Birinchisi, however ni vergul bilan ikki mustaqil gap orasiga qo‘yish. Bu comma splice. Nuqta yoki nuqtali vergul qo‘ying va however dan keyin vergul: “; however,”. Ikkinchisi, “although” bilan “but” ni birga ishlatish. O‘zbekchada “garchi … lekin” normal, inglizchada esa faqat bittasi: although yoki but, ikkalasi birga emas.
scenes.say: The plan is costly; however, it will go ahead. Not: costly, however it will go ahead. And Although it is costly, it will go ahead, never although with but together.
scenes.say_uz: Reja qimmat; biroq u amalga oshadi. Vergul bilan emas. Va although bilan but ni hech qachon birga ishlatmang.

scenes.title: Sabab va natija
board: consequently · as a result · hence · thus
owing to · on account of + noun
given that · in view of the fact that + clause

examples.t: Demand fell; consequently, prices dropped.
examples.uz: Talab tushdi; natijada narxlar pasaydi.

examples.t: Owing to the delay, we missed the deadline.
examples.uz: Kechikish tufayli muddatni o‘tkazib yubordik.

scenes.say_native: Natija: consequently va as a result gap boshida. Hence va thus qisqaroq, ilmiy uslubda. “Thereby” oldingi harakatning natijasini bildiradi va -ing bilan keladi: “The firm cut costs, thereby raising profit”. Sabab: owing to va on account of ot oldidan, “given that” va “in view of the fact that” esa to‘liq gap oldidan keladi. Hammasi “chunki” ga yaqin, lekin grammatik qolipi har xil, shuning uchun keyin nima kelishini bilish muhim.
scenes.say: Demand fell; consequently, prices dropped. Owing to the delay, we missed the deadline. Given that funds are limited, we must choose carefully. The firm cut costs, thereby raising profit.
scenes.say_uz: Talab tushdi; natijada narxlar pasaydi. Kechikish tufayli muddatni o‘tkazib yubordik. Mablag‘ cheklanganini hisobga olsak, ehtiyotkorlik bilan tanlashimiz kerak. Firma xarajatni qisqartirdi va shu bilan foydani oshirdi.

scenes.title: Konsessiya va shart
board: provided (that) · as long as · on condition that

examples.t: Admittedly, the cost is high, but the benefits outweigh it.
examples.uz: To‘g‘ri, xarajat yuqori, ammo foyda undan ustun.

examples.t: We will go ahead provided that funding is secured.
examples.uz: Mablag‘ ta’minlansa, davom etamiz.

scenes.say_native: Konsessiya bu qarshi tomonning haqligini tan olib, o‘z fikringizni davom ettirish. “Admittedly” va “granted” aynan shuni qiladi, bu esseda kuchli usul, chunki siz xolis ko‘rinasiz. Shart uchun: provided that, as long as, on condition that. “Unless” bu “agar … bo‘lmasa”, “otherwise” esa “aks holda”. Unless bilan not ishlatmaymiz: “unless you hurry”, “unless you do not hurry” emas.
scenes.say: Admittedly, the cost is high, but the benefits outweigh it. We will go ahead provided that funding is secured. Hurry, otherwise you will miss it. Unless you hurry, you will miss it.
scenes.say_uz: To‘g‘ri, xarajat yuqori, ammo foyda undan ustun. Mablag‘ ta’minlansa, davom etamiz. Shoshiling, aks holda ulgurmaysiz. Shoshilmasangiz, ulgurmaysiz.

scenes.title: Eng mos bog‘lovchi
board: 1 The idea is sound, ___ risky. (albeit / whereas)
2 ___ the rain, the match went on. (Notwithstanding / Moreover)
3 Hurry, ___ you will miss it. (unless / otherwise)
scenes.say_native: Uchta bo‘sh joyni to‘ldiring. Birinchi: g‘oya to‘g‘ri, garchi xavfli. Ikkinchi: yomg‘irga qaramay, o‘yin davom etdi. Uchinchi: shoshiling, aks holda ulgurmaysiz. Har bir qavsdagi ikki variantdan birini tanlang va sababini ayting.
scenes.say: Choose the best linker. One: The idea is sound, blank risky. Two: blank the rain, the match went on. Three: Hurry, blank you will miss it.
scenes.say_uz: Eng mos bog‘lovchini tanlang. Bir: g‘oya to‘g‘ri, bo‘sh joy xavfli. Ikki: bo‘sh joy yomg‘ir, o‘yin davom etdi. Uch: shoshiling, bo‘sh joy ulgurmaysiz.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: albeit, chunki keyin gap emas, sifat keladi: sound, albeit risky. Whereas bu yerda noto‘g‘ri, u ikki to‘liq gapni solishtirishi kerak edi. Ikkinchi: notwithstanding, chunki keyin ot, the rain. Moreover qo‘shish uchun, ma’noga mos emas. Uchinchi: otherwise, aks holda. Unless bu yerda mantiqqa to‘g‘ri kelmaydi.
scenes.say: One: albeit, followed by an adjective. Two: Notwithstanding, followed by a noun. Three: otherwise, meaning if you do not.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: albeit, keyin sifat keladi. Ikki: notwithstanding, keyin ot keladi. Uch: otherwise, ya’ni agar shoshilmasangiz.

scenes.title: Tinglash: esse haqida suhbat
board: Topic: a draft essay on remote work
scenes.say_native: Endi dialogni tinglang. Repetitor Maya talaba Ravil bilan esse qoralamasini ko‘rib chiqmoqda. Bog‘lovchilarga e’tibor bering: ular nima uchun tanlangan? Keyin savollarga javob berasiz.
scenes.say: Maya: Your argument is strong, albeit a little repetitive. Ravil: I thought the linkers helped. Maya: Some did. However, you use moreover three times in one paragraph. Ravil: So it sounds mechanical? Maya: Exactly. Try using this trend instead, which points back to the idea itself. Ravil: Understood. I will also vary the position of the linkers.
scenes.say_uz: Maya: Dalilingiz kuchli, garchi biroz takroriy. Ravil: Bog‘lovchilar yordam beradi deb o‘ylagandim. Maya: Ba’zilari. Biroq bir xatboshida uch marta moreover ishlatibsiz. Ravil: Demak, mexanik eshitiladi? Maya: Aynan. Buning o‘rniga this trend deng, u g‘oyaning o‘ziga ishora qiladi. Ravil: Tushunarli. Bog‘lovchilar o‘rnini ham almashtiraman.

scenes.title: Tushunish savollari
scenes.say_native: Dialog yuzasidan uchta savol. Birinchi, Mayaning asosiy tanqidi nima? Ikkinchi, u nimani taklif qiladi? Uchinchi, Ravil yana nimani o‘zgartiradi? To‘liq gap bilan javob bering.
scenes.say: Answer in full sentences. One: What is Maya's main criticism? Two: What does she suggest instead? Three: What will Ravil also change?
scenes.say_uz: To‘liq gaplar bilan javob bering. Bir: Mayaning asosiy tanqidi nima? Ikki: u nimani taklif qiladi? Uch: Ravil yana nimani o‘zgartiradi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: bir xatboshida “moreover” uch marta ishlatilgan, bu mexanik eshitiladi. Ikkinchi: “this trend” kabi havola ibora. Uchinchi: bog‘lovchilarning o‘rni, ya’ni gap boshida, o‘rtasida yoki oxirida. E’tibor bering, Maya “albeit a little repetitive” dedi: albeit ni to‘g‘ri, ibora bilan ishlatdi. Bu darsning ikkinchi nuqtasi amalda.
scenes.say: One: moreover was used three times, so it sounds mechanical. Two: a reference phrase such as this trend. Three: the position of the linkers.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: moreover uch marta ishlatilgan, shuning uchun mexanik eshitiladi. Ikki: this trend kabi havola ibora. Uch: bog‘lovchilarning o‘rni.

scenes.title: Ma’lum va yangi axborot

examples.t: The city built a tunnel. The tunnel reduced traffic by a third.
examples.uz: Shahar tunnel qurdi. Tunnel transportni uchdan biriga kamaytirdi.

scenes.say_native: Uchinchi nuqta: xatboshidan xatboshiga bog‘lanish. Asosiy tamoyil: gapni o‘quvchiga tanish axborot bilan boshlang, yangisini oxirga qoldiring. “The city built a tunnel. The tunnel reduced traffic.” Ikkinchi gap boshidagi tunnel tanish, yangi axborot, ya’ni transport kamayishi, oxirida. Shunda har bir gap oldingisiga tayanadi, xuddi zanjir halqalari kabi. Bu yozuvni ravon qiladi.
scenes.say: The city built a tunnel. The tunnel reduced traffic by a third. Begin with what the reader already knows, and end with what is new.
scenes.say_uz: Shahar tunnel qurdi. Tunnel transportni uchdan biriga kamaytirdi. Gapni o‘quvchi biladigan narsa bilan boshlang, yangisini oxirga qoldiring.

scenes.title: Xatboshilar o‘rtasidagi ko‘prik
board: Start of paragraph 2 → picks up X

examples.t: Such costs, however, are only part of the picture.
examples.uz: Biroq bunday xarajatlar rasmning faqat bir qismidir.

scenes.say_native: Xatboshilar orasida ko‘prik kerak. Yangi xatboshining birinchi gapi, ya’ni topic sentence, ikki ishni qiladi: oldingi xatboshining g‘oyasiga ulanadi va yangi fikrni boshlaydi. Masalan: “Such costs, however, are only part of the picture.” Bu yerda “such costs” orqaga ishora, “only part of the picture” yangi yo‘nalishni ochadi. “Firstly, secondly, thirdly” bilan boshlash esa ko‘prik emas, shunchaki raqam.
scenes.say: Such costs, however, are only part of the picture. This sentence points back to the earlier paragraph and opens the next idea. That is a bridge.
scenes.say_uz: Biroq bunday xarajatlar rasmning faqat bir qismidir. Bu gap oldingi xatboshiga ishora qiladi va keyingi g‘oyani ochadi. Mana, ko‘prik shu.

scenes.title: Xatboshi boshidagi xatolar
board: ✗ On the other hand (no “on the one hand”)
✓ On the one hand ... On the other hand ...
scenes.say_native: Uchta xato. Birinchisi, har bir xatboshini “firstly, secondly, thirdly” bilan boshlash, bu raqamlar ro‘yxati, fikr rivoji emas. Ikkinchisi, “on the other hand” ni “on the one hand” siz ishlatish. Bu juft ibora. Uchinchisi, “in the other hand” deyish. Bu noto‘g‘ri, to‘g‘risi “on the other hand”. Old ko‘makchi on, o‘zbekcha “boshqa tomondan” ga qarab in qo‘yib yubormang.
scenes.say: Do not start every paragraph with firstly, secondly, thirdly. And on the other hand needs on the one hand. Never say in the other hand; it is always on.
scenes.say_uz: Har bir xatboshini firstly, secondly, thirdly bilan boshlamang. On the other hand uchun on the one hand kerak. Hech qachon in the other hand demang, har doim on.

scenes.title: Qaysi ochilish bog‘laydi?
board: P1 ends: ... the tax reduced car use.
B  Yet this success hides a problem.
scenes.say_native: Birinchi xatboshi shunday tugaydi: soliq mashina ishlatishni kamaytirdi. Quyida uchta variant bor: A, B, C. Qaysi biri eng yaxshi ko‘prik va nima uchun? Qaysi biri keskin sakrab o‘tadi? Pauza qiling va ayting.
scenes.say: The first paragraph ends: the tax reduced car use. Which opening is the best bridge, A, B or C? Which one jumps abruptly? Why?
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi xatboshi shunday tugaydi: soliq mashina ishlatishni kamaytirdi. A, B yoki C dan qaysi biri eng yaxshi ko‘prik? Qaysi biri keskin sakraydi? Nega?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javob: B. “Yet this success hides a problem” ikki ish qiladi: “this success” bilan oldingi fikrga ulanadi va “yet” bilan burilish beradi. A oldingi fikrga ulanmaydi, yangi mavzu bo‘lib sakrab chiqadi. C esa raqam bilan boshlaydi, ammo mantiqiy ulanish yo‘q. Esda tuting: yaxshi ko‘prik oldingi xatboshining g‘oyasini ushlab turadi.
scenes.say: The answer is B. Yet this success hides a problem points back with this success and turns the argument with yet. A has no link, and C only numbers.
scenes.say_uz: Javob B. Yet this success hides a problem gapi this success bilan orqaga ishora qiladi va yet bilan fikrni burib yuboradi. A da bog‘lanish yo‘q, C faqat raqam beradi.

scenes.title: Mexanik bog‘lashning belgilari
board: Linker at the start of EVERY sentence
scenes.say_native: To‘rtinchi nuqta: mexanik bog‘lashdan qochish. Belgilari: har bir gap bog‘lovchi bilan boshlanadi, bir xil bog‘lovchi takrorlanadi, bog‘lovchi mantiqiy hech narsa qo‘shmaydi. Natija robotga o‘xshaydi. Tajribali yozuvchi bog‘lovchidan kamroq foydalanadi, chunki mantiq gap tuzilishining o‘zida ko‘rinadi. Qoida: bog‘lovchi faqat o‘quvchi mantiqni o‘zi topa olmaydigan joyda kerak.
scenes.say: Mechanical writing opens every sentence with a linker, repeats the same one, or adds a link where no logic is needed. Skilled writers use fewer linkers, because the logic is already in the structure.
scenes.say_uz: Mexanik yozuv har bir gapni bog‘lovchi bilan boshlaydi, bir xilini takrorlaydi yoki mantiq kerak bo‘lmagan joyga qo‘shadi. Tajribali yozuvchilar kamroq ishlatadi, chunki mantiq tuzilishning o‘zida bor.

scenes.title: Oldin va keyin
board: After: one idea flows into the next

examples.t: Remote work saves time. It also widens the talent pool, which helps small firms.
examples.uz: Masofaviy ish vaqtni tejaydi. U iste’dod havzasini ham kengaytiradi, bu kichik firmalarga yordam beradi.

scenes.say_native: Taqqoslang. Oldin: “Remote work saves time. Moreover, it widens the talent pool. Furthermore, it helps small firms.” Moreover va furthermore bir xil vazifani bajaryapti. Keyin: “Remote work saves time. It also widens the talent pool, which helps small firms.” Bitta “also” va bitta “which” yetarli. Ikkinchi variant ravonroq, chunki g‘oyalar bir-biriga tabiiy oqib kiradi.
scenes.say: Remote work saves time. Moreover, it widens the talent pool. Furthermore, it helps small firms. That is mechanical. Now: Remote work saves time. It also widens the talent pool, which helps small firms. Smoother.
scenes.say_uz: Masofaviy ish vaqtni tejaydi. Bundan tashqari, iste’dod havzasini kengaytiradi. Yana, kichik firmalarga yordam beradi. Bu mexanik. Endi: masofaviy ish vaqtni tejaydi. U iste’dod havzasini ham kengaytiradi, bu kichik firmalarga yordam beradi. Ravonroq.

scenes.title: Noto‘g‘ri mantiq
board: ✗ He was tired. On the contrary, he finished.
✓ He was tired. Nevertheless, he finished.
✗ It rained. Besides, we stayed in.
✓ It rained. Consequently, we stayed in.
scenes.say_native: Bog‘lovchi mantiqni noto‘g‘ri ko‘rsatsa, bu mexanik bog‘lashdan ham yomon. “On the contrary” oldingi gapni to‘liq rad etadi: “Is he lazy? On the contrary, he works hard.” “He was tired. On the contrary…” xato, to‘g‘risi nevertheless. Ikkinchi: besides qo‘shish uchun, sabab-oqibat uchun emas, bu yerda consequently kerak. O‘zbekchadagi “aksincha” va “shunga qaramay” ni aralashtirmang.
scenes.say: He was tired. Nevertheless, he finished. Not on the contrary. It rained. Consequently, we stayed in. Not besides. A wrong link is worse than no link.
scenes.say_uz: U charchagan edi. Shunga qaramay, tugatdi. On the contrary emas. Yomg‘ir yog‘di. Natijada uyda qoldik. Besides emas. Noto‘g‘ri bog‘lanish umuman bo‘lmagandan yomonroq.

scenes.title: Matnni silliqlang
board: The app is free. It is fast. It is safe. It is popular.
scenes.say_native: Mana mexanik matn: ilova bepul, tez, xavfsiz va mashhur, to‘rtta qisqa gap. Uni ikki gapda ravon qilib qayta yozing. Hech bo‘lmasa bitta nisbiy gap yoki parallel tuzilma ishlating va bog‘lovchini ko‘pi bilan bitta qoldiring. Pauza qiling.
scenes.say: Rewrite this text in two smooth sentences. The app is free. It is fast. It is safe. It is popular. Use a relative clause or a parallel structure, and keep at most one linker.
scenes.say_uz: Bu matnni ikki ravon gapda qayta yozing. Ilova bepul. U tez. U xavfsiz. U mashhur. Nisbiy gap yoki parallel tuzilma ishlating, ko‘pi bilan bitta bog‘lovchi qoldiring.

scenes.title: Namunaviy javob
board: The app is free, fast and safe, which partly explains why it is so popular.
or: Not only is the app free and fast; it is also safe, hence its popularity.
scenes.say_native: Mumkin variant: “The app is free, fast and safe, which partly explains why it is so popular.” Uchta sifat bir qatorda, bitta “which” sabab-oqibatni beradi, bitta ham moreover yo‘q. Boshqa variant: “Not only is the app free and fast; it is also safe, hence its popularity.” Sizning javobingiz boshqacha bo‘lishi mumkin, muhimi: bog‘lovchilar kamaygan, mantiq saqlangan.
scenes.say: The app is free, fast and safe, which partly explains why it is so popular. Or: Not only is the app free and fast; it is also safe, hence its popularity. Fewer linkers, same logic.
scenes.say_uz: Ilova bepul, tez va xavfsiz, bu uning nega mashhurligini qisman tushuntiradi. Yoki: ilova nafaqat bepul va tez; u xavfsiz ham, shu sababli mashhur. Bog‘lovchilar kam, mantiq o‘sha-o‘sha.

scenes.title: Tinglash: hisobotni tahrirlash
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog. Hamkasblar Sem va Layla bozor hisobotini tahrirlayapti. Ular qanday muammoni topishini tinglang.
scenes.say: Sam: Read this paragraph. It says that sales fell, and this was caused by prices, and this led to losses. Leila: Three this words, and none is clear. Which one means prices? Sam: The second, I think. Leila: Then write this rise in prices. And merge the last two sentences using which. Sam: Better. Shall I add however somewhere? Leila: Only if there is a real contrast. There isn't.
scenes.say_uz: Sem: Mana bu xatboshini o‘qing. Unda sotuv tushdi, bu narxlar tufayli bo‘ldi va bu zararga olib keldi deyilgan. Layla: Uchta this, birortasi aniq emas. Qaysi biri narxni anglatadi? Sem: Menimcha, ikkinchisi. Layla: Unda this rise in prices deb yozing. Oxirgi ikki gapni which bilan birlashtiring. Sem: Yaxshiroq. Biror joyga however qo‘shaymi? Layla: Faqat haqiqiy qarama-qarshilik bo‘lsa. Bu yerda yo‘q.

scenes.title: Savollar
board: 1 What is wrong with the three this words?
2 How does Leila fix the second?
scenes.say_native: Uchta savol. Birinchi, uchta “this” bilan nima muammo? Ikkinchi, Layla ikkinchisini qanday tuzatadi? Uchinchi, nega u “however” qo‘shishga rozi emas? Pauza qiling va ayting.
scenes.say: Three questions. One: what is wrong with the three this words? Two: how does Leila fix the second one? Three: why does she refuse however?
scenes.say_uz: Uch savol. Bir: uchta this bilan nima muammo? Ikki: Layla ikkinchisini qanday tuzatadi? Uch: nega u however ga rozi emas?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: uchala “this” noaniq, o‘quvchi qaysi biri nimaga ishora qilayotganini bilmaydi. Ikkinchi: “this rise in prices”, ya’ni yig‘uvchi ot bilan. Uchinchi: haqiqiy qarama-qarshilik yo‘q, bog‘lovchi esa faqat mantiq bor joyda kerak. Layla aytgan fikr: bog‘lovchi bezak emas, xizmat.
scenes.say: One: none of them is clear. Two: this rise in prices. Three: because there is no real contrast, and a linker must reflect real logic.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: birortasi aniq emas. Ikki: this rise in prices. Uch: haqiqiy qarama-qarshilik yo‘q, bog‘lovchi esa haqiqiy mantiqni aks ettirishi kerak.

scenes.title: Nutqda bog‘lovchilar

examples.t: Well, it depends. Anyway, let's move on.
examples.uz: Xo‘sh, bog‘liq. Baribir, davom etaylik.

scenes.say_native: Og‘zaki nutqda bog‘lovchilar boshqacha. Esseda moreover yaxshi, suhbatda esa g‘alati. Nutqda well, so, right, anyway, actually, in fact ishlatiladi. Talaffuz: gap boshidagi “However,” dan keyin kichik pauza bo‘ladi, bu pauza vergulga mos keladi, ovoz esa ko‘pincha pastga-yuqoriga ketadi. Nutqda moreover o‘rniga “and what’s more” yoki “on top of that” desangiz tabiiyroq eshitiladi.
scenes.say: In speech we say well, so, anyway, actually. However, with a short pause, is also natural. But moreover sounds odd in conversation; say what's more or on top of that.
scenes.say_uz: Nutqda well, so, anyway, actually deymiz. Qisqa pauza bilan however ham tabiiy. Lekin moreover suhbatda g‘alati eshitiladi; what's more yoki on top of that deng.

scenes.title: Matnni tahrirlash vazifasi
board: Cities grow. Cities need housing. Cities need transport. Cities are expensive.
scenes.say_native: Yakuniy mashq. Mana matn: shaharlar o‘sadi, shaharlar uy-joy talab qiladi, shaharlar transport talab qiladi, shaharlar qimmat. Uni havola, ellipsis va bitta mos bog‘lovchi bilan qayta yozing. Ko‘pi bilan uchta gap. Pauza qiling.
scenes.say: Final task. Cities grow. Cities need housing. Cities need transport. Cities are expensive. Rewrite in at most three sentences, using reference, ellipsis and one well-chosen linker.
scenes.say_uz: Yakuniy topshiriq. Shaharlar o‘sadi. Shaharlar uy-joy talab qiladi. Shaharlar transport talab qiladi. Shaharlar qimmat. Havola, ellipsis va bitta mos bog‘lovchi bilan ko‘pi bilan uchta gapda qayta yozing.

scenes.title: Namunaviy tahrir
board: Cities grow, and with this growth come demands for housing and transport. Both, however, are costly.
scenes.say_native: Namuna: “Cities grow, and with this growth come demands for housing and transport. Both, however, are costly.” Nimalar ishladi? “This growth” havola va yig‘uvchi ot. “Housing and transport” bitta ibora, “demands for” takrorlanmaydi, bu ellipsis. “Both” ikkalasiga ishora, “however” esa real burilish beradi. To‘rtta gap o‘rniga ikkita, ma’no saqlandi.
scenes.say: Cities grow, and with this growth come demands for housing and transport. Both, however, are costly. This growth is reference, both points back, and however marks a real turn.
scenes.say_uz: Shaharlar o‘sadi va bu o‘sish bilan uy-joy va transportga talab keladi. Biroq ikkalasi ham qimmat. This growth havola, both orqaga ishora qiladi, however esa haqiqiy burilishni bildiradi.

scenes.title: Darsning xulosasi
scenes.say_native: Xulosa. Birinchi: havolada “this” dan keyin yig‘uvchi ot qo‘ying. Ikkinchi: takrorni one, do so, so bilan almashtiring, o‘quvchi tiklay oladigan narsani tushirib qoldiring. Uchinchi: bog‘lovchini ma’no va uslub bo‘yicha tanlang: albeit, notwithstanding, thereby, admittedly. To‘rtinchi: xatboshilar orasida ko‘prik quring va bog‘lovchini kamaytiring, mantiqni tuzilishga bering.
scenes.say: To sum up: use this plus a summary noun, substitute and omit what the reader can recover, choose linkers by meaning and register, build bridges between paragraphs, and use fewer linkers, better placed.
scenes.say_uz: Xulosa: this va yig‘uvchi otdan foydalaning, o‘quvchi tiklay oladigan narsani almashtiring yoki tushiring, bog‘lovchini ma’no va uslub bo‘yicha tanlang, xatboshilar orasida ko‘prik quring, bog‘lovchini kam, ammo o‘rinli ishlating.

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi va keyingi dars
board: Homework: Improve the cohesion of a given text
Success: ≥5 changes, no vague this, 1 bridge
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi: o‘zingiz tanlagan yoki ustozingiz bergan 150–200 so‘zli mexanik matnni toping va kogeziyasini yaxshilang. Mezon: kamida beshta o‘zgartirish kiriting, bitta ham noaniq “this” qolmasin, kamida bitta xatboshi ko‘prigi bo‘lsin va bog‘lovchilar soni kamaysin. Keyingi darsda argumentli esse yozishni, yetti-sakkiz ball darajasidagi namunalar bilan o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: Your homework: take a mechanical text of about one hundred and fifty to two hundred words and improve its cohesion. Make at least five changes, leave no vague this, and add one paragraph bridge. Next time we write argumentative essays.
scenes.say_uz: Uy vazifangiz: taxminan 150–200 so‘zli mexanik matnni olib, kogeziyasini yaxshilang. Kamida beshta o‘zgartirish kiriting, noaniq this qoldirmang va bitta xatboshi ko‘prigi qo‘shing. Keyingi darsda argumentli esse yozamiz.

homework_uz: O‘zingiz tanlagan yoki ustozingiz bergan 150–200 so‘zli mexanik matnni toping va kogeziyasini yaxshilang. Mezon: kamida beshta o‘zgartirish, bitta ham noaniq this qolmasin, kamida bitta xatboshi ko‘prigi bo‘lsin va ortiqcha bog‘lovchilar kamaysin.

options: Prices rose. This trend surprised us.
Prices rose, and it surprised us.
Prices rose. That is surprising it.
quiz.why_uz: Yig‘uvchi ot bilan this aniqroq: this trend. Yolg‘iz this noaniq bo‘lishi mumkin.

options: The plan is costly, however it will go ahead.
The plan is costly; however, it will go ahead.
The plan is costly however, it will go ahead.
The plan is costly, but however it will go ahead.
quiz.why_uz: However ikki mustaqil gapni vergul bilan bog‘lamaydi: nuqtali vergul yoki nuqta kerak.

quiz.q: Complete: The results were useful, ___ limited.
quiz.why_uz: Albeit dan keyin sifat yoki ibora keladi, gap emas.

quiz.q: Complete: ___ the delay, the event went ahead.
quiz.why_uz: Notwithstanding old ko‘makchi, keyin ot keladi.

options: Although it rained, but we went out.
Although it rained, we went out.
Despite it rained, we went out.
Although it rained, however we went out.

quiz.q: I need some advice. Please give me ___.

quiz.why_uz: Butun gapga ishora qiluvchi nisbiy gap which bilan boshlanadi.

quiz.q: Which phrase needs “on the one hand” before it?
quiz.why_uz: On the other hand juft ibora: on the one hand ... on the other hand.

quiz.q: He was tired. ___, he finished the job.
quiz.why_uz: Nevertheless shunga qaramay ma’nosini beradi; on the contrary rad etadi.

quiz.q: Which is the best way to avoid mechanical linking?
options: Start each sentence with a linker
Use the same linker for every addition
Let structure carry some of the logic
quiz.why_uz: Mantiqning bir qismini tuzilma (nisbiy gap, parallelizm) ko‘tarsin; bog‘lovchilar faqat kerak joyda.
